name: Lollie Vox
blurb: The stage name of Laurie Webb, singer, songwriter, and co-producer of this podcast, known for her FL Studio demo songs, with her music, a YouTube channel, and a free vocal sample pack on the site.

name: The Vegas Cocks
blurb: Nashville rock and roll, described in their own words as uncured, high-octane gutter-snipe rock and roll.

name: Tommy Womack
blurb: Nashville songwriter and author with three books, eight solo albums, and a past in Government Cheese and Daddy, and a two-time winner of the Nashville Scene critics-poll songwriting award.

name: Government Cheese
blurb: Indie rock band from Bowling Green, Kentucky, together since 1985 and known for energetic live shows, now preparing a ninth release to be recorded in Nashville with producer Brad Jones.

name: Jonell Mosser
blurb: Nashville singer working in soul, roots, and blues for four decades, with credits alongside Ringo Starr, Don Was, and Levon Helm.

name: Lisa Stewart
blurb: Nashville vocalist blending country, jazz, and blues, an RCA/BNA recording artist, BMI Award–winning songwriter, and CMA Horizon Award nominee.

name: Alan Messer Photography
blurb: Award-winning Nashville photographer in his 48th year behind the lens, with galleries, signed prints and books.

name: K. Butler Guitars
blurb: Custom guitars and basses built in Tennessee by a luthier with more than thirty years in the trade. Models include The '64 V2, The Shark Guitar, The Cheetah and The Wrangler.
